name: InfiniteScroll
description: Accessible scroll container that requests additional data on intersection or near-bottom scrolling; application controls data fetching.

accessibility.fallback: Native button to request more without scrolling
accessibility.status: aria-live polite status for loading and end

lifecycle.request: Only one in flight; loading state prevents duplicate requests
lifecycle.completion: Application appends data and calls complete; no component network calls
lifecycle.observer: IntersectionObserver with passive scroll fallback; callbacks from disconnected/replaced observers ignored.
